_readme: JoJo's Blocks — NAVIGATION + CATEGORY REGISTRY. Single source for the header menu, the Products dropdown and the footer links. A category with status 'live' gets a real link; status 'soon' renders as a non-link 'Soon' item — no dead links and no empty pages, ever. A 'menu' item renders a dropdown whose children come from 'explore'. To activate a category: (1) create its content and data file, (2) set status to 'live' and give it an href, (3) re-run the generator. Never link a category that has no content. Instagram is intentionally absent: @rz.views publicly displays the owner's first name, so it stays unlinked until the owner decides otherwise. Hrefs are site-root relative (for example 'index.html#books'); the generator rewrites them per page (prefix '../' for books/, '#books' instead of 'index.html#books' on the homepage itself).
